cover.learning_purpose: Identify the lesson and its central decision at a glance.
cover.title: EI06 · Building an MVP · cover
cover.caption: Identify the lesson and its central decision at a glance. Choose the smallest experiment that tests a consequential assumption.
cover.alt_text: A learner tests a small manual room-booking board before investing in automation, with an observation notebook nearby.
cover.extended_description:
Choose the smallest experiment that tests a consequential assumption.

Before building automated room matching, manually coordinate a small authorized group using a shared schedule. Measure successful bookings and effort to learn whether coordination solves the problem.

An MVP tests a consequential assumption; it need not automate the whole product.

No text, letters, numbers, logos, arrows, diagram boxes, robots, brains, hooded hackers, neon or fake UI. Lesson Building an MVP. Objective: smallest experiment testing a consequential assumption.
